question: What happens when the inauspicious part is purified?
premises: there is no decrease of enjoyment itself
the enjoyer constantly enjoys from maya's abode to the end
inference: When the inauspicious part is purified, enjoyment itself does not decrease; the enjoyer constantly enjoys from the abode of maya to the end.
plain_english: When the inauspicious part is purified, there is no decrease of enjoyment itself; this enjoyer constantly enjoys from the abode of maya to the end.
